issues: Cookie Consent modal intercepts pointer events on top of page CTAs (Send button on /contractor/aid, blog tile anchors on /blogs, Pricing CTAs). Setting bidvex_cookie_consent v1 in localStorage was NOT enough — the live key is bidvex_cookie_consent_v2. Real users dismiss the banner before clicking, but automated agents and any future Playwright/SDET runs must either click 'Accept All Cookies' first or pre-seed both bidvex_cookie_consent AND bidvex_cookie_consent_v2 keys. Functionally non-blocking, but slows test harnesses.
